posts.name: carolyn.r.choate
posts.cooked:
My husband and I love SotM so much that these days we pre-order anything that shows up. It's by far our favorite game and since my husband gets more replay out of games than the average gamer, we play it a whole lot.

So we were browsing the webpage a few weeks ago and he said to me, "How come we don't have Sentinels Tactics? We should get that."

It did seem really weird to me too since I remember it coming out and planning to buy it because it was SotM related.

Then the next day I got an email through Kickstarter that told me that they were waiting to ship our Tactics but I hadn't provided an address!

Mystery solved. Of course we had ordered it through Kickstarter months ago and I forgot all about it. I'm glad that email came right when it did or I might have ordered it twice. 

We got the game just a few days later and now we're trying to figure out how to play it!
